name: features_advertised
invariant: INV-20 — a host is written to only for scopes it advertises
notes: The features[] list the desktop hub advertises over GET /api/v1/cluster, read from the single source sync::HUB_FEATURES (so it can never drift from the routes the hub mounts). Two journal scopes plus `dataset_ingest`, the follower-to-hub write half of the file plane (/datasets/{uuid}/ingest* and GET /datasets/{uuid}/db, see docs/design/dataset-push.md). Phase 7a grows this list (registry_reads, chat, ...) as the website host learns to serve them, and the same list must then be served unchanged by the website — the cross-host parity assertion INV-20 names. That parity cuts both ways: a host that does not mount the ingest routes (today's website) must NOT advertise `dataset_ingest`, because every client default-denies an unadvertised capability rather than probing for it.
